crossRefs.note: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.
Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

translations.web: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
translations.bsb: No one of illegitimate birth may enter the assembly of the LORD, nor may any of his descendants, even to the tenth generation.
translations.kjv: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
translations.asv: A bastard shall not enter into the assembly of Jehovah; even to the tenth generation shall none of his enter into the assembly of Jehovah.
